_why: RULING-REGISTER-REACH-01 (2026-10-07). A doctrine section that ATTRIBUTES ITSELF to a board is a ruling by its own words. Two things must then be true: it NAMES its item id, and that id is in a register the settled-ground scan reads. Both were measured when this shipped and both are DEBT, not exemptions -- the ruling registers are far younger than CoachingPrinciples.md, so most of these predate them. The baselines stop the numbers GROWING. They do not shrink them, and nothing in this repo schedules that.
_found_by: PROGRESSION-TRANSITION-01 shipped with all three artifacts and no register row while audit-docs.sh printed ALL CLEAN. The existing arm reads BACKLOG HEADINGS and that ruling never passed through the backlog. ⚠️ The first cut of THIS check could not see it either: its own amendment is written as a BLOCKQUOTE, and the matcher was anchored to line start. The second cut still could not: the section named no item id at all. Both fixed; the id is now in the §8 heading.
